purpose: Separate human-readable EcoReport outputs from token-efficient AI-to-AI exchange packets.

sourceLearnings.name: Bloomberg AI
sourceLearnings.pattern: Responses are grounded in trusted data with transparent attribution and source-text access.

sourceLearnings.name: Fiscal.ai
sourceLearnings.pattern: AI summaries sit beside financial data, KPI data, dashboards, notifications, and click-through auditability.

sourceLearnings.name: AlphaSense
sourceLearnings.pattern: Premium documents, broker reports, news, semantic search, and sentiment are combined for qualitative research.

sourceLearnings.name: FINRA AI guidance
sourceLearnings.pattern: Existing securities rules continue to apply when using GenAI and LLMs.

sourceLearnings.name: Koyfin
sourceLearnings.pattern: Portfolio, watchlist, macro dashboards, transcripts, ETF/fund coverage, and customizable visuals are one research surface.

sourceLearnings.name: The Transcript AI
sourceLearnings.pattern: Earnings intelligence is separated into executive summary, key metrics, management tone, guidance, strategic signals, red flags, Q&A dynamics, and uncertainty-aware ranking.

sourceLearnings.name: AlphaVistaAI
sourceLearnings.pattern: Specialist AI agents combine technical, fundamental, sentiment, real-time data, portfolio diversification, and investor-profile insights.

sourceLearnings.name: Motley Fool investor survey
sourceLearnings.pattern: Retail investors use GenAI mainly for stock research, market-trend analysis, news/filing summaries, portfolio management, and time savings; accuracy/privacy remain major concerns.
